records.title: Expansion of Coimbatore and salem airports
details:
a) to (c): The proposal for construction of a New
Integrated Terminal Building (T3), along with additional apron bays, at
Coimbatore Airport is presently at a preliminary stage in the Airports Authority of India (AAI), subject to receipt of requisite Government approvals,
availability of land, and statutory/regulatory clearances

records.title: Commercial Aero-Related Manufacturing
details: a to b: For commercial production of Hansa-3 (NG) an EoI has been issued to identify the prospective firm to take up manufacturing.

records.title: Delay in NEET Exam 2024
details: As on 22.11.2024, the CBI has filed five charge sheets in NEET(UG) 2024 paper theft case against a total of 45 accused. Names of Candidates, who are beneficiaries of the paper theft / unfair means and names of the MBBS students who had solved the stolen paper or who had appeared in exam as impersonators have already been identified and sent to concerned authority for necessary action.

records.title: CREATION OF NEW MINISTRY.
details: a to e: The draft policy has been prepared and is under finalization.
